steps.say: Substituting \(a_n = r^n\) gives the characteristic equation \(r^2 - [[c1]]r + [[c2]] = 0\), whose roots are \([[r1]]\) and \([[r2]]\).
Distinct roots give the general solution \(a_n = A \cdot [[r1]]^n + B \cdot [[r2]]^n\).
The initial conditions give \(A + B = [[a0]]\) and \([[r1]]A + [[r2]]B = [[a1]]\), so \(A = [[a]]\) and \(B = [[b]]\).
Substituting gives \(a_n = [[value]]\). Check: at \(n = 0\) the value is \([[a0]]\), and at \(n = 1\) it is \([[a1]]\).
